title: Say what an audit didn't check
statement: Make every check and audit list, item by item, what it read and skipped, and treat the rest as unchecked until covered: a clean result proves only what was read.
example: Six green audits failed a real review because none had asked which sources had never been ingested.
detail: The reading project's certification contract says closed-world audits must say so: a pass that checks only the sources it ingested has to declare that scope, because six green audits failed a real review when none of them had asked what sources existed that were never ingested (`grade3-reading/artifacts/cert-layer/CONTRACT-v0-2026-08-31.md`). A critic of a later adherence audit, which had read the designs and the served lesson files, listed what that audit could not have checked, from rendered and hidden pages, audio and reading pace to the film, lesson timing and authorities it never consulted, because what the child sees is not what the file holds (`grade3-reading/artifacts/curriculum-adherence-2026-09-24/CRITIC.md`). A readiness plan's gate likewise asks for unobserved and blocked coverage to be stated explicitly (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-2026-09-16/PLAN.md`). Unrecognised fields count among what a check did not read. Cover what lies beyond the scope as well, because defects gather just outside a check's scope.
against: Phone and tablet findings were later ranked below the laptop student view: fixed if cheap, never blockers (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0207-memory-digest-project-reference-user.qmd`, lines 1501-1525). The count check's weakness was rated a judgment, not an observed failure, since the reason for each bump was checked every time (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/GAPS-2026-09-11.md`).
